svg.text: Upgraded 2D Circuit Schematic — Conditional Two-Load (Light + Motor) 12 V DC Monitoring Proposal
Not As-Built • Documentary Engineering Design & Safety Audit • Reconciled 100% with component_list.csv (42 items) & wiring_connections.csv (W001–W060)
Dedicated Home-Run Return Conductor to JGND Star
WARNING: Do NOT Connect to 96 V EV Simulator
1. 12 V DC Power Distribution, Branch Sensing Boundaries & Dedicated Star Return (W001–W021, W052–W060)
18.0 V DC sense ceiling is a calculation assumption only • All fuses (F1, FL, FM, F2), wire gauges, switches, and protection parts (RP1, TVS1, D1) are TBD
W011: Dedicated High-Current Motor Return (MDRV.INPUT− → JGND.STAR_RETURN)
Verify 3.3V pullups & probe wire colors first
Key Topological Corrections in This Upgraded Schematic (Compared to Prior Package SVG):
1. Eliminated Daisy-Chained Return Bug (Finding I10): L1 (W007), MDRV (W011), U_BUCK_BOARD IN− (W014), and U_ESP/Buck OUT− (W016/W017) use separate
home-run conductors to JGND.STAR_RETURN and JGND.LOGIC_GND (joined by Kelvin tie W053) so motor return drop cannot corrupt single-ended ADC readings.
2. Added Missing Netlist Components & Returns (Findings I12, I13): Explicitly drew DC/DC converter ground leads (W014, W016), downstream motor M1 (W054, W055),
unified conditioner designator U_I_L (W022, W023), sensor supply/ground ports (W018–W021), decoupling C_BYP_M/C_FILTER_M (W056–W059), and RP1/TVS1/D1.
3. Construction Gate Warning: Do NOT energize until F1, FL, FM, F2, SW1, WIRE gauges, S_L, U_BUCK_BOARD, and MDRV are physically identified and rated.
2. Analog Measurement Front End & Classic ESP32 ADC1 Interface
Characterized 11 dB window: 150–2450 mV (S2) • Powered GPIO abs max: −0.3 V to 3.6 V • Unpowered (VDD=0V): 0.3 V max
CHANNEL 1: LIGHT BRANCH CURRENT INTERFACE (W022–W023 → Candidate GPIO32 / ADC1_CH4)
Or I²C SDA/SCL if INA219 used
Note: Do not assume ACS712-30A for S_L (at 0.5 A, scaled shift is 14.04 mV vs ±60 mV ADC error = ±427% error). Keep S_L & U_I_L TBD.
CHANNEL 2: LIGHT INPUT VOLTAGE DIVIDER 1 (W024–W030 → Candidate GPIO33 / ADC1_CH5)
CHANNEL 3: MOTOR CURRENT SCALER (W031–W037 → Candidate GPIO34 / ADC1_CH6 Input-Only)
CHANNEL 4: MOTOR-DRIVER DC INPUT VOLTAGE DIVIDER 2 (W038–W044 → GPIO35 / ADC1_CH7)
Senses MDRV DC supply input (NOT switched PWM motor terminals) • Ratio k = 5/39 ≈ 0.128205 • R_th = 8.718 kΩ • f_c = 182.56 Hz
Analog Front-End Safety, Sequencing & Calibration Rules (Findings C1, C5, I1, I2, R5, R6):
• Superseded Legacy Dividers Retired: Legacy 120 kΩ / 22 kΩ reaches 2.7887 V nom (2.8362 V worst-1%) at 18 V, and legacy
15 kΩ / 20 kΩ reaches 2.5600 V at +30 A—both exceed Espressif's 2.45 V 11 dB accuracy limit. Use 68 kΩ / 10 kΩ and 27 kΩ / 20 kΩ.
• Unpowered MCU Injection Hazard (Finding R6): When ESP32 is unpowered (VDD = 0 V), absolute max pin voltage is 0.3 V.
An energized 5 V ACS712 (1.064 V @ 0 A) or 12–18 V divider (1.54–2.31 V) injects current into unpowered GPIO ESD diodes.
• Open Bottom-Resistor Fault: If R_LL, R_VL, or R_ML opens, full branch voltage (via 68 kΩ) or 5 V sensor output (via 27 kΩ) hits the GPIO.
• Ratiometric 5 V Drift: ACS712 zero-current point is V_CC / 2. A ±2% (±100 mV) drift on the 5 V buck rail shifts zero by ±50 mV
raw (±0.758 A equivalent error). Calibrate V_ZERO at true zero primary current and verify buck regulation before measurement.
• Breakout Verification: Confirm S_M_BOARD has no onboard output voltage divider before adding R_MH (27 kΩ) / R_ML (20 kΩ).
